name: Ura Seitokai yo, Koumon o Seiatsu Seyo!
original_name: 裏生徒会よ、肛門を制圧せよ！
source:
Oppress the ass! It's the student council's raison d'etre!

Pull off secret maneuvers as a member of the "backend" student council!
Dominate the anus of the real council leader, that smug bitch.
This isn't just play; chase girls down and wreck their tightest, shyest hole!

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE182058.html]DLsite English[/url]]
